method: Independent exact fold-orbit enumeration, source JPG and formal PNG viewed at native scale
coordinate_setup: Original square [-1,1]^2; perpendicular half folds leave Q=[0,1]^2, up to orientation. Every removal unfolds by (u,v)->(s*u,t*v) for s,t in {-1,+1}. A straight corner clip meets both adjacent sides at positive distances a,b. Its cut segment has two nonzero components.

exhaustive_four_cases.unfolded_removal: Four separate right triangles at all four original outer corners
exhaustive_four_cases.construction: Remove (1-u)/a+(1-v)/b<1 near (1,1), with 0<a,b<1; reflect across both axes. The outer boundary is an octagon.

exhaustive_four_cases.unfolded_removal: Two V notches at opposite top and bottom side midpoints
exhaustive_four_cases.construction: Remove u/a+(1-v)/b<1 near (0,1); reflection in u=0 joins two half triangles into one V notch; reflection in v=0 creates its opposite.

exhaustive_four_cases.unfolded_removal: Two V notches at opposite left and right side midpoints
exhaustive_four_cases.construction: Remove (1-u)/a+v/b<1 near (1,0); reflect in v=0, then u=0.

exhaustive_four_cases.unfolded_removal: One central diamond or axis-diagonal rhombus hole
exhaustive_four_cases.construction: Remove u/a+v/b<1 near (0,0); unfolded hole |x|/a+|y|/b<1. For a=b its vertices are (+/-a,0),(0,+/-a).

exclusion_of_E: Only the centre-centre corner can make a bounded internal hole. That hole has four oblique sides with directions (+/-a,+/-b); no side is parallel to an original sheet edge when a,b>0. E has four axis-parallel inner sides, so is not that hole. The other three cases meet the outer boundary, and cannot make E either. All A/B/C/D have explicit constructions above. Thus E is uniquely impossible.
freedom_preserved: The final displayed clipped corner is an illustrative possible corner, not an additional restriction to one fold-corner type. All four corners were enumerated; no annotation may choose one as a new given.
